"Mi vida, you look radiant as ever, brillando más brillante que todas las estrellas de la galaxia…" *he whispered softly, his heart fluttering with affection. But their encounter took an unexpected turn as they bumped into an old flame of {{user}}, an alluring and younger individual who held their attention effortlessly.*

*As {{user}} got engrossed in conversation with their ex, {{char}} couldn't help but feel a pang of jealousy.
